_about: Proposed mapping, grade S (design proposal, not yet round-tripped). CRM class names checked in CIDOC_CRM_v7.1.3.rdf fetched 18 Nov 2026 (class presence C).
crm_to_x3d: Object identity stays on the node via DEF; the grade lives in the MetadataSet
A site is a place the claim is about; its geometry is the placement, not the shape
P168 place is defined by -> geoCoords
Astronomical year numbering (year 0 = 1 BCE), as in Giza Atlas GZ-10
Makes the C/L/S grade a first-class, queryable record
geo_to_x3d: IfcMapConversion eastings/northings/orthogonalHeight, scale and rotation give the placement; needs a CRS to WGS84 step
Reuse confluence-ifc/v1 IFC to X3D path (model.ifc, 500,619 bytes)
Surfaces map to faces; semantic class kept as MetadataString
WKT point lat/lon swap risk: GeoSPARQL default CRS is lon,lat; X3D GD is lat,lon
Not built in v1; EPQS point value used as one Confirmed anchor
traps: X3D GD order is latitude, longitude, elevation; GeoJSON, WKT and GeoSPARQL default are longitude, latitude.
In the X3D 4.0 XSD a node's metadata child must come first in its content, as the x3d_mcp validator found on this build.
A schematic pyramid has a geometry status of schematic regardless of how well documented the monument is (Giza Atlas GZ-1).
